about: Training-set vectors for the pocket models over the whole training manifest: the original model (torch); the shipping int8 file (onnx/vision.int8-per-channel.onnx) in onnxruntime CPU (its results depend on the build machine's processor, which is recorded); and the same file in onnxruntime-web 1.30.0's WASM build (4 single-thread processes per machine; WASM arithmetic is the same on every machine, and it is what the page computes). Shards are rows modulo n. The plan job waits for the manifest.
